topic: AWS data transfer and local storage performance
summary_markdown: The conversation covered technical details regarding AWS S3 data handling. One participant noted that they downloaded necessary files for the first month from s3-to-s3 and are loading them directly into a database. A discrepancy was noted in the cost calculation for intercontinental S3-S3 transfer: one source cited $0.00033/GB, while another (Gemini) suggested $0.02/GB, potentially costing ~$100 for the first and second months. The discussion also touched upon local storage performance, noting that an NVMe4 recording limit was 131MB/s with 100% I/O utilization. A comparison of data transfer speeds was made, contrasting a high speed (11.8Gb/s) when writing to memory versus hitting a write limit when writing to disk. The feasibility of migrating services to Hetzner was briefly discussed in the context of low expected traffic and minimal cost.
decisions: The participant will continue investigating data transfer costs between AWS regions.
